title: Closed Image Characterizations of Locally Finite Groups via Cellular Automata
summary: We prove that a group $G$ is locally finite if and only if, for some (equivalently, every) infinite set $A$, every cellular automaton $A^G\to A^G$ has closed image in the prodiscrete topology. Equivalently, this holds if and only if every linear cellular automaton $V^G\to V^G$ has closed image for some pair $(K,V)$ with $V$ infinite-dimensional over the field $K$ (equivalently, for every such pair). This gives affirmative answers to Open Problems 6 and 7 of Ceccherini-Silberstein and Coornaert. More precisely, if $G$ is not locally finite, then for every infinite set $A$ there is a finite-memory cellular automaton $A^G\to A^G$ with non-closed image, and for every field $K$ and every infinite-dimensional $K$-vector space $V$ there is such a linear cellular automaton $V^G\to V^G$. The common obstruction is constructed on a countable direct-sum alphabet from an infinite ray in a locally finite Cayley graph. A direct-summand argument gives arbitrary vector-space alphabets, while an alphabet-retract principle gives arbitrary infinite set alphabets.

AI.tldr: 证明群 $G$ locally finite 当且仅当在 prodiscrete 拓扑下每个 cellular automaton $A^G\to A^G$ 都有闭像，肯定回答了 Ceccherini-Silberstein 与 Coornaert 的 Open Problems 6 和 7。
AI.motivation: cellular automaton 的像是否闭是符号动力系统与群论的基本问题。此前不清楚“闭像”性质是否精确刻画 locally finite 群。
AI.method: 若 $G$ 非 locally finite，则在 locally finite Cayley graph 的一条无限射线上、以可数 direct-sum 字母表构造像非闭的 finite-memory CA；direct-summand 论证给出任意向量空间字母表，alphabet-retract 原理给出任意无限集字母表。
AI.result: $G$ locally finite $\iff$ 对某个（等价地每个）无限集 $A$，每个 CA $A^G\to A^G$ 有闭像；线性版本对无限维 $V$ 同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 闭像性质精确刻画了 locally finite 群，统一了集合与线性两种情形。
AI.future_work: 研究闭像失败的定量程度；探索该刻画在其他动力性质中的类比。

title: Turán numbers of $4$-uniform tight even cycles minus one edge
summary: For every integer $k \ge 1$ and sufficiently large $n$, we show that the extremal construction for the Turán number of the $4$-uniform tight cycle of length $4k+2$ minus one edge is a complete odd-bipartite $4$-graph. In particular, since $C_{6}^{4-}$ contains the $4$-uniform expanded triangle as a subgraph, our result extends that of Frankl and Keevash--Sudakov on the Turán density and the Turán number of the $4$-uniform expanded triangle. We also show that the Turán density of $C_{4k+2}^{4}$ is $1/2$ for all integers $k \ge 2$, and establish the corresponding stability result. This strengthens the result of Sankar on the Turán density of $C_{4k+2}^{4}$ which holds only for all sufficiently large $k$.

AI.tldr: 确定了 $4$-uniform tight even cycle 去掉一条边（长 $4k+2$）的 Turán 数极值构造为 complete odd-bipartite 4-graph，并证明 $C_{4k+2}^4$ 的 Turán 密度对所有 $k\ge2$ 为 $1/2$。
AI.motivation: 超图 Turán 问题极难，tight cycle 及其变体是核心测试对象。$C_6^{4-}$ 含 expanded triangle，故此结果推广 Frankl 与 Keevash–Sudakov 的经典工作。
AI.method: 对足够大的 $n$ 刻画极值构造并建立 stability；将去边 tight cycle 与 expanded triangle 联系起来。
AI.result: 极值构造为 complete odd-bipartite 4-graph；$\pi(C_{4k+2}^4)=1/2$ 对所有 $k\ge2$ 成立并带 stability，强化了 Sankar 仅对充分大 $k$ 的结果。
AI.conclusion: tight even cycle 减一边的极值问题有干净的 odd-bipartite 极值结构，且 Turán 密度对所有 $k\ge2$ 稳定为 $1/2$。
AI.future_work: 处理长度 $\equiv0\pmod 4$ 的 tight cycle；推广到更高 uniformity。

title: Non-acyclic spaces of line transversals
summary: Cheong, Goaoc and Holmsen conjectured that every connected component of the space of line transversals to a family of pairwise disjoint open convex sets in $\mathbb{R}^d$ is acyclic. We disprove this conjecture by showing that the homology may be nontrivial in any fixed dimension provided that $d$ is large enough. More precisely, we show that for every $n \geq 1$ there is a finite family of pairwise disjoint open convex sets in $\mathbb{R}^{3n}$ such that the $(n-1)$st homology (over an arbitrary ring) of the space of line transversals to this family is nonzero.

AI.tldr: 否证了 Cheong–Goaoc–Holmsen 的猜想：两两不交开凸集族的 line transversal 空间的连通分支未必 acyclic——当维数足够高时同调可在任意固定维非平凡。
AI.motivation: line/flat transversal 空间的拓扑是几何 transversal 理论核心。此前猜测其连通分支总是 acyclic。
AI.method: 在高维空间中显式构造两两不交开凸集族，使 transversal 空间产生非平凡同调。
AI.result: 对每个 $n\ge1$，存在 $\mathbb{R}^{3n}$ 中两两不交开凸集有限族，使其 line transversal 空间的第 $(n-1)$ 阶同调（任意系数环）非零。
AI.conclusion: transversal 空间可以任意复杂，acyclicity 猜想在高维彻底失效。
AI.future_work: 确定使同调非平凡所需维数的精确阈值；研究低维（如 $d=3,4$）情形。

title: Fixed-density profiles for the semi-induced 4-vertex star
summary: We study the fixed-density semi-inducibility profiles of the red-blue star $S_{2,1}$, which has one distinguished center, two red edges and one blue edge. For an $n$-vertex graph $G$, let $N(S_{2,1},G)$ be the number of injective labeled copies in which the two red edges of $S_{2,1}$ are mapped to edges of $G$ and its blue edge is mapped to a non-edge of $G$, that is, \begin{align*} N(S_{2,1},G)= \sum_{v\in V(G)} d(v)(d(v)-1)(n-1-d(v)). \end{align*} For every fixed red edge density $β\in[0,1]$, we determine both extremal $S_{2,1}$-densities. On the upper side, we prove the missing low-density range and, together with the theorem of Balogh, Lidický, Mubayi, Pfender and Volec for $β\ge 1/4$, obtain the full four-branch profile predicted in their work. On the lower side, we show that the natural endpoint profile coming from the quasi-star and quasi-clique constructions is not universal; the correct minimum is given by a one-parameter three-class complement-split family. The proofs use a transfer argument with degree-square tie-breaking, reducing the extremal analysis to almost-regular, threshold and finite-staircase optimizations.

AI.tldr: 确定了 red-blue 半诱导 4-顶点星 $S_{2,1}$ 在固定红边密度 $\beta$ 下的两侧极值 density，补全上界低密度段并修正了下界的正确极值族。
AI.motivation: semi-inducibility 是 inducibility 的加权推广。$S_{2,1}$（两红边一蓝边）的完整 profile 此前仅在 $\beta\ge1/4$ 已知。
AI.method: transfer 论证配合 degree-square tie-breaking，将极值分析归约为 almost-regular、threshold 与 finite-staircase 优化。
AI.result: 对每个 $\beta\in[0,1]$ 确定两侧极值密度：上界补全低密度段得到完整四分支 profile；下界的正确极小由单参数三类 complement-split 族给出（非 quasi-star/quasi-clique 端点）。
AI.conclusion: $S_{2,1}$ 的极值 profile 比自然构造更微妙，下界极值族需重新刻画。
AI.future_work: 推广到其他小的 red-blue 图案；研究 semi-inducibility 的通用极值结构。

title: Variations of Helly's theorem for convex splinters
summary: A convex splinter $K$ is a union of convex sets in $\mathbb{R}^d$ such that every minimal affine dependent set of $\mathbb{R}^d$ contained in $K$ is contained in one of the sets. The study of convex splinters was motivated by the study of flat transversals to convex sets. We extend several variations of Helly's theorem from convex geometry to convex splinters. These include fractional and colorful variations of Helly's theorem. We also extend Tverberg's theorem to convex splinters.

AI.tldr: 将 Helly 定理的多个变体（fractional、colorful 及 Tverberg 定理）推广到 convex splinter。
AI.motivation: convex splinter（凸集之并且任一极小仿射相关子集落在某一凸集内）源于对凸集 flat transversal 的研究，需要相应的 Helly 型工具。
AI.method: 将凸几何中的 Helly/Tverberg 论证适配到 splinter 的仿射相关性结构。
AI.result: 证明了 convex splinter 版本的 fractional Helly、colorful Helly 与 Tverberg 定理。
AI.conclusion: 经典 Helly 理论的核心组合结论在 splinter 框架下依然成立，为 flat transversal 研究提供工具。
AI.future_work: 发展 splinter 的 $(p,q)$ 定理与更多凸组合结论。

title: Spectral Radius, Vertex Deletion, and Chromatic Number of Signed Graphs
summary: A signed graph $Σ=(G,σ)$ is a graph $G$ with edges given signs $1$ or $-1$ defined by the function $σ$. The adjacency matrix of $Σ$ is defined as per these signs. The relation between the largest eigenvalue of $G$ and $G-v$ has been studied in recent years, where $G-v$ is the graph obtained from $G$ by deleting the vertex $v$. In 2020, Sun and Das proved that the difference of the squares of the largest eigenvalues of the graphs $G$ and $G-v$ is bounded above by $2d(v)-1$ where $d(v)$ is the degree of $v$. A similar result need not be true for the largest eigenvalues of signed graphs. In this paper, we prove that the result is valid for the spectral radius of signed graphs. On the other hand, the signed graph version of Hoffman's chromatic number bound and Cvetkovic's lower bound was proved by Wang et al. in 2021. They also discussed the difficulty in proving the extended version encompassing all eigenvalues of $Σ$ as was done for unsigned graphs by Wocjan et al. We give a lower bound for the chromatic number in terms of all the eigenvalues of $Σ$ and $Σ_-$, where $Σ_-$ is the spanning subgraph induced by the negative edges.

AI.tldr: 证明了 signed graph 的 spectral radius 满足 Sun–Das 型顶点删除界 $s(\Sigma)^2-s(\Sigma-v)^2\le 2d(v)-1$，并给出用 $\Sigma$ 与 $\Sigma_-$ 全部特征值表示的 chromatic number 下界。
AI.motivation: 最大特征值与顶点删除的关系在普通图中已知，但对 signed graph 未必成立；Hoffman/Cvetković 型着色界的全特征值推广此前受阻。
AI.method: 对 signed adjacency matrix 的 spectral radius 建立顶点删除比较；用 $\Sigma$ 与负边导出子图 $\Sigma_-$ 的全谱构造着色下界。
AI.result: 证明 spectral radius 的 $2d(v)-1$ 顶点删除界对 signed graph 成立；给出 signed chromatic number 关于全部特征值的下界。
AI.conclusion: signed graph 的谱–结构关系可以恢复无符号图的经典界，并突破了全特征值着色界的困难。
AI.future_work: 寻找上述界的极值 signed graph；探索其他谱着色不等式的 signed 版本。

title: A Resolution of Erdős Problem 550 on Tree versus Complete Multipartite Ramsey Numbers
summary: We resolve Erdős Problem 550, originally asked as question (2) of Erdős, Faudree, Rousseau, and Schelp. Precisely, for fixed integers $k\geq 2$ and $1\leq m_1\leq \cdots \leq m_k$, we prove that, for every sufficiently large $n$ and every $n$-vertex tree $T$, $R(T,K_{m_1,\ldots,m_k}) \leq (k-1)(R(T,K_{m_1,m_2})-1)+m_1$. The proof combines a new off-Turán tree-embedding theorem with a compactness-and-rounding theorem for represented bounded-rank hypergraph obstructions. The embedding theorem follows from Szemerédi regularity and a local regular-matching embedding lemma of Hladký and Piguet. The compactness argument uses shadow hypergraphs to retain obstructions whose vertices escape along the limiting sequence.

AI.tldr: 解决 Erdős Problem 550：证明对充分大 $n$ 与任意 $n$ 顶点树 $T$，$R(T,K_{m_1,\ldots,m_k})\le(k-1)(R(T,K_{m_1,m_2})-1)+m_1$。
AI.motivation: 树对完全多部图的 Ramsey 数是 Erdős–Faudree–Rousseau–Schelp 提出的经典问题，长期悬而未决。
AI.method: 结合一个新的 off-Turán 树嵌入定理与对 bounded-rank 超图障碍的 compactness-and-rounding 定理；嵌入定理基于 Szemerédi regularity 与 Hladký–Piguet 的局部正则匹配嵌入引理，compactness 用 shadow hypergraph 保留障碍。
AI.result: 证明上述 sharp 上界，完整解决 Erdős Problem 550。
AI.conclusion: 树对完全多部图的 Ramsey 数可由二部情形线性组合精确控制。
AI.future_work: 去掉“充分大 $n$”的限制；推广到森林或有界度图作为宿主/目标。

title: Coloring sparse random Cayley graphs
summary: It is shown that there exists $c > 0$ so that the Cayley graph over any finite abelian group $Z$ generated by $c \log |Z|$ random elements is properly 3-colorable with high probability (as $|Z| \to \infty$). This is asymptotically tight and improves the best-known bound due to Alon of $\frac{1}{4}\log \log |Z|$ elements. It also makes progress toward Alon's suggestion that a bound of $c \log |G|$ may hold for any finite solvable group $G$.

AI.tldr: 证明存在常数 $c>0$，使任意有限交换群 $Z$ 上由 $c\log|Z|$ 个随机元素生成的 Cayley graph whp 可正常 3-着色，渐近最优并大幅改进 Alon 的 $\tfrac14\log\log|Z|$。
AI.motivation: 稀疏随机 Cayley graph 的着色数是 Alon 提出的问题，此前最好界仅为 $\log\log$ 量级。
AI.method: 概率论证结合稀疏随机 Cayley graph 的结构分析，控制其局部与全局着色障碍。
AI.result: $c\log|Z|$ 个随机生成元即 whp 3-着色，界 asymptotically tight，并向 Alon 关于任意有限可解群成立 $c\log|G|$ 的猜测迈进。
AI.conclusion: 随机 Cayley graph 的可着色性由 $\log|Z|$ 量级的生成元数控制，远优于此前认知。
AI.future_work: 处理一般有限可解群；确定常数 $c$ 的最优值。
